test_case.test_name: Parameterized PCIe NIC endpoint/path AER status check
test_case.purpose: Verify the intended NIC endpoint and reporting path retain expected link negotiation with no disallowed device/AER status or new PCIe error event during the observation window.
required_package: pciutils with privilege sufficient for complete configuration-space decoding
Runtime NIC PN/serial/netdev/driver/firmware to domain:BDF and upstream/root-port map
Project expected link speed/width and any explicitly approved nonzero status exception mask
Pre/post observation-window timestamps and preserved kernel/journal; optional rasdaemon provenance
Secure target access and reviewed Script revision
test_case.test_command: Resolve endpoint/path identity; capture complete privileged `lspci -s <BDF> -vvv` for endpoint and designated reporting path before and after the window, plus full timestamped kernel/journal and optional rasdaemon evidence; parse DevSta,LnkSta,CESta,UESta without clearing or resetting anything.
test_case.expected_result: Endpoint/path identities remain present; link speed/width equals the project recipe; by default DevSta error flags and CESta/UESta are clear and no new AER event appears. Any signed exception mask/baseline is applied explicitly and no new bit/event or severity escalation occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete privileged decode, correct topology, expected link and all default/approved masks satisfied with no new attributable event. Missing capability/permission, wrong BDF, new correctable/nonfatal/fatal/unsupported-request bit, link downgrade/retrain, device disappearance or unapproved historical state fails; project exceptions must be versioned, never inferred.
safety_gate: Read-only PCI config/log collection only; no clear/reset/injection/config write.
Verify endpoint and upstream identities before interpretation.
Preserve full logs and sticky baseline; do not truncate or clear evidence.
Stop and escalate on any new error/downgrade without automatic repair/retry.
expected_evidence: NIC and full PCIe path identity map
Complete pre/post endpoint/path lspci transcripts and parsed field matrix
Full timestamped kernel/journal/optional rasdaemon event attribution
test_case.recovery: No state is changed. On error preserve the exact configuration/log evidence and stop; remediation or reset requires a separate approved diagnostic/recovery case.
